context: Evaluates correct use of spprof for multi-threaded profiling. Checks that the candidate starts profiling before threads are created, waits for all threads to complete before stopping, and correctly iterates over Profile.samples to extract per-thread information.

checklist.name: Profiler started before threads
checklist.description: spprof.start() is called before any threading.Thread is created or started

checklist.name: All threads joined before stop
checklist.description: All 3 worker threads are joined (t.join()) before spprof.stop() is called

checklist.name: Sample thread_id extracted
checklist.description: profile.samples is iterated and thread_id is accessed from each Sample object to build a set of unique thread IDs

checklist.name: Unique thread count printed
checklist.description: The count of unique thread IDs is printed in the format 'threads observed: <n>'

checklist.name: Total sample count printed
checklist.description: The total number of samples is printed in the format 'total samples: <n>'
